{"consolidated_memory":"**Off-by-one day bug in ui/components/DatePicker.tsx (TypeScript, web ui)**

Common symptom across all occurrences:
- Problem: off-by-one day in the date picker
- Repro: pick the first of the month and reopen
- Signal: selected value one day behind the label
- Covering test: ui/components/DatePicker.test.tsx

**INCIDENT 1 [2026-03-11] - c010-e0:**
- Trigger: clients pinned to v1 SDK
- Root cause: unbounded retry loop with no backoff
- Fix: capped the attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter
- PR #4425 on branch fix/off-by-one-day-1
- Result: backlog cleared 15 minutes after deploy

**INCIDENT 2 [2026-03-17] - c010-e1:**
- Trigger: sessions arriving through OAuth provider
- Root cause: connection pool exhaustion under burst load
- Fix: raised the pool ceiling and put a bounded wait queue in front of it
- PR #5386 on branch fix/off-by-one-day-2
- Result: p99 latency fell from 6.9 s to 702 ms

**INCIDENT 3 [2026-07-25] - c010-e2:**
- Trigger: records carrying non-ASCII names
- Root cause: two writes never wrapped in a transaction
- Fix: wrapped both writes in one transaction
- PR #7244 on branch fix/off-by-one-day-3
- Result: nightly rollup matched source counts for 42 days running

All fixes applied to the same file (ui/components/DatePicker.tsx) but targeting different root causes and affecting different populations."}
